name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd
about: Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart) is a national supermarket chain, with a focus on value-retailing. We offer a wide range of products with a focus on the Foods, Non-Foods (FMCG) and General Merchandise & Apparel product categories.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: And so therefore, 15% kind of a gross margin and let's say around a 5% kind of a net margin should be the North Star for this business even in the future.
items.why: Filed results show net profit of Rs 1,603 crore on Rs 38,439 crore of revenue in the first half, a 4.2% margin.

guidance.note: DMart rarely holds calls; only the August 2026 call is on file, and its store-opening goal cannot yet be checked.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 23.3% a year over 5 years

claims.summary: All 3 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 106% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 1 days to pay, against 1 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 2% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 10% while operating profit grew 15%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 28%, against 27% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.16× equity, against 0.04× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 74.5%, down 0.2 points over the last 4 reported quarters.
